verses.en: O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD, all the earth.
verses.pt: Cantai ao Senhor um cântico novo, cantai ao Senhor, todos os moradores da terra.
verses.en_web: Sing to Yahweh a new song! Sing to Yahweh, all the earth.
verses.en_bbe: O make a new song to the Lord; let all the earth make melody to the Lord.

verses.en: Sing unto the LORD, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.
verses.pt: Cantai ao Senhor, bendizei o seu nome; anunciai de dia em dia a sua salvação.
verses.en_web: Sing to Yahweh! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!
verses.en_bbe: Make songs to the Lord, blessing his name; give the good news of his salvation day by day.

verses.en: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.
verses.pt: Anunciai entre as nações a sua glória, entre todos os povos as suas maravilhas.
verses.en_web: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.
verses.en_bbe: Make clear his glory to the nations, and his wonders to all the peoples.

verses.en: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.
verses.pt: Porque grande é o Senhor, e digno de ser louvado; ele é mais temível do que todos os deuses.
verses.en_web: For great is Yahweh, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.
verses.en_bbe: For the Lord is great, and greatly to be praised; he is more to be feared than all other gods.

verses.en: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the LORD made the heavens.
verses.pt: Porque todos os deuses dos povos são ídolos; mas o Senhor fez os céus.
verses.en_web: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but Yahweh made the heavens.
verses.en_bbe: For all the gods of the nations are false gods; but the Lord made the heavens.

verses.en: Honour and majesty are before him: strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
verses.pt: Glória e majestade estão diante dele, força e formosura no seu santuário.
verses.en_web: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
verses.en_bbe: Honour and glory are before him: strong and fair is his holy place.

verses.en: Give unto the LORD, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
verses.pt: Tributai ao Senhor, ó famílias dos povos, tributai ao Senhor glória e força.
verses.en_web: Ascribe to Yahweh, you families of nations, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.
verses.en_bbe: Give to the Lord, O you families of the peoples, give to the Lord glory and strength.

verses.en: Give unto the LORD the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.
verses.pt: Tributai ao Senhor a glória devida ao seu nome; trazei oferendas, e entrai nos seus átrios.
verses.en_web: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.
verses.en_bbe: Give to the Lord the glory of his name; take with you an offering and come into his house.

verses.en: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.
verses.pt: Adorai ao Senhor vestidos de trajes santos; tremei diante dele, todos os habitantes da terra.
verses.en_web: Worship Yahweh in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.
verses.en_bbe: O give worship to the Lord in holy robes; be in fear before him, all the earth.

verses.en: Say among the heathen that the LORD reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.
verses.pt: Dizei entre as nações: O Senhor reina; ele firmou o mundo, de modo que não pode ser abalado. Ele julgará os povos com retidão.
verses.en_web: Say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.
verses.en_bbe: Say among the nations, The Lord is King; yes, the world is ordered so that it may not be moved; he will be an upright judge of the peoples.

verses.en: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.
verses.pt: Alegrem-se os céus, e regozije-se a terra; brame o mar e a sua plenitude.
verses.en_web: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!
verses.en_bbe: Let the heavens have joy and the earth be glad; let the sea be thundering with all its waters;

verses.en: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice
verses.pt: Exulte o campo, e tudo o que nele há; então cantarão de júbilo todas as árvores do bosque
verses.en_web: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy
verses.en_bbe: Let the field be glad, and everything which is in it; yes, let all the trees of the wood be sounding with joy,

verses.en: Before the LORD: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.
verses.pt: diante do Senhor, porque ele vem, porque vem julgar a terra: julgará o mundo com justiça e os povos com a sua fidelidade.
verses.en_web: before Yahweh; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.
verses.en_bbe: Before the Lord, for he is come; he is come to be the judge of the earth; the earth will be judged in righteousness, and the peoples with unchanging faith.
